# pylopdf (archived)

> `pylopdf` is archived (`0.16.1` is its final release). Use `pyropdf` instead (`pip install pyropdf`, `import pyropdf`).

Successor documentation and LLM context:
- pyropdf documentation: https://pyropdf.haya.works/
- pyropdf Japanese documentation: https://pyropdf.haya.works/ja/
- pyropdf llms.txt: https://pyropdf.haya.works/llms.txt
- pyropdf full documentation (llms-full.txt): https://pyropdf.haya.works/llms-full.txt
- pyropdf Japanese llms.txt: https://pyropdf.haya.works/ja/llms.txt
- pyropdf repository: https://github.com/yhay81/pyropdf
- pyropdf PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/pyropdf/
- pyropdf foundation design: https://github.com/yhay81/pyropdf/blob/main/DESIGN.md

Migration notes from pylopdf 0.16 to pyropdf:
- Install `pyropdf` (`pip uninstall pylopdf && pip install pyropdf`) and replace `import pylopdf` with `import pyropdf`.
- Extras `ocr`, `jp`, `ko`, `zh-cn`, and `zh-tw` reuse the same data packages (`pylopdf-ocr-models`, `pylopdf-fonts-*`). Load other script fonts with `pyropdf.Font.from_file(...)`.
- Page boxes are display-space properties (`page.media_box`, `page.crop_box`, `page.bleed_box`, `page.trim_box`, `page.art_box`) instead of `page.boxes.*`.
- Create new documents with `doc = pyropdf.Document()`, `doc.pages.new(...)` or `doc.pages.new_from_image(...)`, and `page.draw()` instead of `pylopdf.create()`.
- `doc.save()` preserves untouched objects by default (`compress=False, prune=False`); pass `compress=True, prune=True` to rewrite for size or `incremental=True` to append changes.
- `PyropdfWarning` replaces `PylopdfWarning`.
- For `pylopdf` 0.15 or `pymupdf` code, `python -m pylopdf.migrate` from `pylopdf[migrate]==0.16.1` can rewrite to the 0.16 API before switching imports to `pyropdf`.
